methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Security Council resolutions are organized by adoption year on main.un.org. Each year has its own page under the pattern /securitycouncil/en/content/resolutions-adopted-security-council-{year}. The site is server-rendered Drupal.

## Search
No per-page keyword search API. Navigation is by YEAR: substitute {_year} into the URL template to reach that year's resolution list. This is the primary filter and the reason for the year filterSchema entry.

## Filters
Year filter (param _year) is encoded directly in the URL. Each year page lists resolutions S/RES/{N} (YYYY) in descending order.

## Download
Record-page flow. Per-year pages do not host local PDFs; they link resolutions out to the UN document system: docs.un.org (e.g. https://docs.un.org/en/s/res/2755(2024)) and digitallibrary.un.org (record pages like https://digitallibrary.un.org/record/4051310?v=pdf) which serve multilingual PDFs. includeAllLinks harvests those outbound record links, then the PDF is fetched from the record page.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Resolution symbol and year parse from S/RES/{N}(YYYY). The digital library record page offers richer metadata (title, subject) but no clean JSON API was verified. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
The main.un.org host sits behind bot protection (plain WebFetch GETs returned 403), so a realistic User-Agent or headless browser may be needed to fetch the year pages, even though the content is server-rendered. The per-year URL pattern and outbound docs.un.org / digitallibrary.un.org PDF links were confirmed via web search.
probeNotes: WebFetch of the 2024 page redirected www.un.org -> main.un.org and then returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare/bot protection). WebSearch confirmed the per-year URL pattern (.../resolutions-adopted-security-council-{year}), that pages list S/RES/{N}(YYYY) resolutions, and that resolutions link out to docs.un.org (docs.un.org/en/s/res/2755(2024)) and digitallibrary.un.org record pages serving multilingual PDFs. Added year filter param _year as specified.
